div.head: II Cn 71a
div.ab: Eorles swa ðærto gebyrige, þæt syndon VIII hors, IIII gesadelode ⁊ IIII unsadelode, ⁊ IIII helmas ⁊ IIII byrnan ⁊ VIII spera ⁊ eallswa fela scylda ⁊ IIII swurd ⁊ twa hund mances goldes.
Eorles. Eorles swa ðærto byrie, þæt syndon eahta hors, IIII gesadelode ⁊ IIII unsadolede, ⁊ IIII helmas ⁊ IIII byrnan ⁊ VIII spera ⁊ swa fela scylda ⁊ IIII swyrd ⁊ twa hund mancus goldes.
Eorles swa þærto gebyrige, þæt sindon eahta hors, feower gesadolode ⁊ feower ungesadelode, ⁊ feower helmas ⁊ IIII byrnan ⁊ ehta spera ⁊ ealswa fela scylda ⁊ IIII swurd ⁊ twa hund mancos goldes.
Comitis sicut ad eum pertinet, hoc est octo equi, quatuor sellati, quatuor insellati, et galeę quatuor et loricę IIII cum octo lanceis et totidem scutis et gladii quatuor et CC mancę auri.
Comitis, sicut decet comiti, id est octo equos, IIII cum sellis et quattuor sine sellis, IIII galeas et quattuor loricas, octo lanceas et totidem scuta et quinquaginta mancas auri.
Comitis, sicut decet, que sunt VIII equi, quatuor sellati et IIII non sellati, IIII galee et IIII lorice, octo lancee et totidem scuta, IIII gladii necnon ducente mance auri.
Eorles. Eorles swa ðærto byrie, þæt syndon eahta hors, IIII gesadelode ⁊ IIII unsadolede, ⁊ IIII helmas ⁊ IIII byrnan ⁊ VIII spera ⁊ swa fela scylda ⁊ IIII swyrd ⁊ twa hund mancus goldes.
Eorles swa ðærto gebyrige, þæt syndon VIII hors, IIII gesadelode and IIII unsadelode, and IIII helmas and IIII byrnan and VIII spera and eallswa fela scylda and IIII swurd and twa hund mances goldes.

(Eines Grafen. B) Eines Grafen, wie dazu gehört, nämlich 8 Pferde, 4 gesattelt und 4 ungesattelt, und 4 Helme und 4 Panzer und 8 Lanzen und ebenso viele Schilde und 4 Schwerter und 200 Mancus [25 Pfund] Gold.

(Of an earl. B) An earl's, as belongs to it, namely 8 horses, 4 saddled and 4 unsaddled, and 4 helmets and 4 mail-coats and 8 spears and as many shields and 4 swords and 200 mancuses [25 pounds] of gold.

An earl's heriot. The heriot of an earl, as is fitting, shall be eight horses, four saddled and four unsaddled, and four helmets and four byrnies and eight spears and as many shields and four swords and 200 mancuses of gold.

an earl’s as belongs thereto, namely eight horses, four saddled and four unsaddled, and four helmets and four coats of mail and eight spears and as many shields and four swords and 200 mancuses of gold;

The tribute to be paid by an earl, as is proper, shall be eight horses, four saddled and four unsaddled, and four helmets, four mail shirts, eight spears, just as many shields, four swords, and two hundred mancuses of gold.

Vgl. Gl ebd. 9b; Eorl 6; Pferd 7. 9a. Der Herr schenkte oder lieh, wie bei anderen Germanen, dem Gefolgsmann Streitrosse.—Auch in den Testamenten ist die Hälfte der Pferde gesattelt und herrscht die Zahl 2 oder 4 vor: Bi 1132. 1306; Crawford chart. p. 23. Waffen und gesattelt Pferd sind das Voraus aus dem Nachlasse der Frau für den Gatten; Södermänn. Recht bei Fritz Erbfolge Schwed. in Sav. Zs. RG., Germ. 36, 199

Cf. Gl ibid. 9b; Eorl 6; Pferd 7. 9a. The lord, as among other Germanic peoples, gave or lent war-horses to his retainer.—In the wills too half of the horses are saddled, and the number 2 or 4 predominates: Bi 1132. 1306; Crawford chart. p. 23. Weapons and a saddled horse are the husband’s preferential share from the wife’s estate; law of Södermanland, in Fritz Erbfolge Schwed. in Sav. Zs. RG., Germ. 36, 199

Nicht ⅛ Pfund Gold (so Schmid und meine Übs.), sondern die Byzantinische Goldmünze oder ihr Rechnungswert von ⅛ £ Silbers. Ich berichtigte es Gl: Heergewäte 5.—Ein Testament verfügt allgemein: minum hlaforde þæt gold to minum heregeatum; Birch 1306

Not ⅛ pound of gold (so Schmid and my transl.), but the Byzantine gold coin or its money-of-account value of ⅛ £ of silver. I corrected this in Gl: Heergewäte 5.—A will provides in general terms: minum hlaforde þæt gold to minum heregeatum; Birch 1306
